metadata.document: Submission on Modernising Conservation Land Management

cleaned_body_text: Submission on Modernising Conservation Land Management. Submitter details: Environmental Defence Society Incorporated, PO Box 91736, Victoria Street West, Auckland 1142. Introduction: This is a submission by the Environmental Defence Society (EDS) on the Department of Conservation’s Modernising Conservation Land Management Document. EDS supports the need to modernise and streamline the conservation management planning system, but expresses strong concerns that the proposals in the Discussion Document need substantial improvements and a stronger conservation-focused lens.
